note: E8; E13: deriving short-, medium- and long-term targets through the SBTi target-setting approach is still stated as a future intent in the FY2024 report and again in FY2025; E4 lists SBTi validation as an FY2025 target. E1-E2 give a 2035 and a 2050 target but no near-term one and not from the SBTi exercise, so the FY2024 exercise was postponed.
E3-E5; E7: in 2024 only 89% of nucleus estate hectarage and 22 of 27 mills were ISPO certified, and the target for all estates and all mills is re-dated to end 2026 (E4). E12 still 89% in 2025.

E8; E13-E14: WSA completion is reported for all factories in Thailand only; nothing in 2024 or 2025 says whether the overseas production sites were assessed. E10 is a supplier water-stress assessment, a different exercise.

E3; E6: recordable work-related injuries fell from 15 (FY2022) to 11 in FY2023 and the performance column records a decrease. Note one workplace fatality from an offsite traffic accident (FY2022: zero) in the same year; E9 shows injuries rose again to 19 in FY2024.
E3; E6: FY2023 reports zero confirmed incidents of corruption and the target table marks it Met.

E4: FY2021 performance column says no material changes in market presence during the period, still one of the largest independent distributors in Southeast Asia; a maintain target met on the company's own statement.
E2: FY2021 average training hours were 6.1 per employee (restated to 5.2 in E10) against 15; E10-E11 show the 15-hour target was only met in FY2022.

E3-E7; E8: the FY2021 report describes the phase-out approach (phased plan, no CFC sales, new gases usable in equipment) and restates the roadmap target for FY2022, but gives no verdict on whether the FY2021 roadmap was met. Subject discussed, target not settled.

E1; E3; E7: in FY2024 ThaiBev launched est Cola 515 ml in a 100% rPET bottle, a commercial product using rPET. The evidence does not name Sermsuk or Oishi as the launching unit and says nothing about the Oishi PCR shrink film, which is not the extracted metric.

E1-E2: FY2024 reports no non-monetary sanctions or significant fines relating to non-compliance with laws and regulations and carries the zero non-compliance target into FY2025. The result is phrased in terms of sanctions and fines rather than cases.
E5-E6: FY2022 electricity use was 69 kWh per square foot against 61 in FY2021 and the company states it did not meet the FY2022 target.
E6: FY2025 reports no recorded cases of non-compliance in relation to product health and safety; E8 renews the zero target for FY2026.

E13; E15: the 2023 report says football (teaching) clinics have operated in 70 provinces so far, short of 77, but the promise's antecedent for 'the clinics' is not identified in the extraction and the evidence also has safety clinics (E10) and medical clinics (E14); cannot be sure the figure is this target. No 2022 result on the clinics; E11's 77 provinces is a social enterprise, not clinics.
E7-E8: FY2024 average training hours were 8.6 per employee against 15, and the Group plans to catch up in coming years; E10-E11 show 13 hours in FY2025, still below target.

E6; E8-E9: the FY2022 target table marks the improve-NPS target as not achieved (No) because NPS was not computed, the methodology having been deemed ineffective; management intends to change the methodology.
